title: site-agent.json
description: Per-repository configuration read by the azmx-site plugin. Lives at the root of the website repository, next to its documentation. Holds identifiers and paths only; never a key.

name.description: How the site is referred to in answers, e.g. "AZM X website".

finalDomain.description: The domain the site will move to, if not switched yet.

defaultLocale.description: BCP 47 tag of the default language at /, e.g. "ar".

locales.description: Every language and its path prefix.

path.description: Path prefix, "/" for the default language.

positioning.description: The one approved description of the company, per language. Agents use it verbatim and never substitute another.

projectId.description: The Framer project id. Not a secret by itself: it grants nothing without a key.

publish.description: human-only: the plugin never publishes to production. allow-with-flag: a production publish is allowed only when AZMX_SITE_ALLOW_PUBLISH=1 is set for that command.

handbook.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the handbook guide (Markdown).

siteMap.description: Path of the generated site map (Markdown).

review.description: Path of the review log (findings and changes, newest first).

plans.description: Folder of plans and design directions.

backups.description: Folder where JSON backups of changed Framer nodes are saved before a write.

code.description: Folder holding copies of the site's code components, overrides and scripts.

rules.description: The repository's rules file for Claude (usually CLAUDE.md).

extra.description: Other documentation worth searching, with a one-line description each.
